Title: General availability: Azure Ultra Disk Storage in Sweden Central

Body.Content:
Azure Ultra Disk Storage offers high throughput, high IOPS, and consistent low latency disk storage for Azure virtual machines (VMs). Ultra Disk Storage is suited for data-intensive workloads such as SAP HANA, top tier databases, and transaction-heavy workloads.

Learn more about Azure Ultra Disk Storage.
